specName: W3C public-agent-conformance reporting format, per-check record
identifierPolicy: A requirement identifier is minted by this corpus and bound to the normative sentence by sha256 over its bytes. The texts this corpus cites carry no identifiers, and a message number or a section number names a position rather than a sentence.

families.w3c-f-1: row 1: a non-verdict state with no cause
families.w3c-f-2: row 2: void with a cause that describes a unit never examined
families.w3c-f-4: row 4: a confinement failure during the check as the cause, and the state is not void
families.w3c-f-5: row 5: a declared exclusion whose state is not not-exercised
families.w3c-f-6: row 6: a non-verdict state carrying a qualifier
families.w3c-f-7: row 7: a verdict state carrying a cause
families.w3c-f-8: row 8: other-verdict foreclosed beside discrimination demonstrated
families.w3c-f-9: row 9: discrimination demonstrated beside an other-verdict that is not demonstrated
families.w3c-f-10: row 10: foreclosed without its constraint set and domain
families.w3c-f-11: row 11: an asserted qualifier value without its evidence reference
families.w3c-f-12: row 12: discrimination demonstrated citing evidence whose changed slot is the checker
families.w3c-f-13: late addition (a): a roll-up says whether its checks could have gone negative
families.w3c-f-14: late addition (a): a prior discriminating run binds the check identity that survived
families.w3c-f-15: late addition (b): a digest over a set binds its leaf count and names its tree shape; domain separation alone is not the fix
families.w3c-f-16: declared slots: moved is contained in the declared compared set
families.w3c-f-29: late addition (a), amended in the comment window: a control built to fail is bound to the checker and constraint set of the checks it speaks for
families.w3c-f-17: roll-up: the aggregate carries its complete denominator
families.w3c-f-18: roll-up: the counter over carried against referenced recomputes
families.w3c-f-19: closed vocabulary: a value outside a registry is not read
families.w3c-f-20: carry-or-reference: a digest that resolves with a mismatch is an integrity failure, over the check set and over a referenced observation alike
families.w3c-f-21: recomputed delta: moved is read as recomputed over the observations, not as declared
families.w3c-f-22: coverage block: scope disclosure in controlled fields, with the pre-cap file count
families.w3c-f-23: population denominator: a completeness claim carries the size of its population
families.w3c-f-24: delta-related pair: unrelated pass and fail records do not witness discrimination
families.w3c-f-25: row 13 (proposed): other-verdict demonstrated citing an object whose recomputed moved does not contain the verdict; unresolvable, the row degrades
families.w3c-f-26: row 14 (proposed): moved asserted on an object that neither carries its observations nor references them with digests
families.w3c-f-27: arity: recomputed from the delta, never declared
families.w3c-f-28: domain: declared once at run level, named by identifier and never restated
families.w3c-f-gaps: the two known gaps of the reference emitter, closed: void has a slot and not-exercised carries a cause
families.w3c-f-disensor: the 42 delta-related pairs of the disensor corpus at 1e36257, re-cut against v0.1
families.arm-f-run: agent run metrics: the Run object's own members
families.arm-f-steps: agent run metrics: the Step objects and their order
families.arm-f-usage: agent run metrics: the Usage invariants and the cache-write ledger
families.arm-f-totals: agent run metrics: the totals as the sum of the steps
families.arm-f-serialization: agent run metrics: timestamps, identifiers, labels, cost and extensions
families.lcd-f-publisher: context discovery: what the origin advertises and serves
families.lcd-f-consumer: context discovery: what a consumer resolves, retrieves and attributes

origin.note: The twelve rejection rows and the record definition are the author's, consolidated on the list on 2026-09-15 and handed over on 2026-09-18. The domain is declared once at run level
Reporter MUST emit "1" while conforming to this specification

The "end" member MUST be present when "status" is "completed",
   "failed" or "aborted", and MUST NOT be present when "status" is
   "running"
When present, "end" MUST NOT be earlier than "start"

a Reporter MUST NOT emit
   a value other than the four listed

When the "steps" array is present, "step_count" MUST be
   greater than or equal to the length of that array

Within one Run, "index" values MUST be unique and MUST be assigned in
   the order in which Steps began

When "kind" is "model_invocation", the "usage" and "model" members
   MUST be present

When "kind" is "tool_call", the "tool" member MUST
   be present and the "usage" member MUST NOT be present
All members of a Usage object MUST be non-negative integers

"cache_read_tokens" is a subset of "input_tokens" and therefore
       MUST be less than or equal to it

"cache_read_tokens" and "cache_write_tokens"
       denote disjoint subsets of "input_tokens" and their sum MUST be
       less than or equal to "input_tokens"

"totals" object MUST be, member by member, the sum of the
   corresponding members of every Step's Usage object

One
   "lifetime" value MUST NOT appear in more than one element of the same
   array

The sum of the "tokens" members of "cache_writes" MUST equal the
   "cache_write_tokens" member of the same Usage object

A Reporter MUST NOT
   emit two Steps of one Run with the same "invocation_id"

A Run that emits "root_run_id" and has no
      parent MUST set it equal to its own "run_id"

The "amount" member MUST be a JSON string matching the ABNF [RFC5234]
   rule

Its value MUST be a JSON object whose members all
   have string values

Timestamps MUST be strings conforming to the "date-time" production
   of [RFC3339].  They MUST use the "Z" time offset

MUST be non-empty strings of at most 128
   characters

A Reporter MUST NOT use an unprefixed member
   name for a purpose other than the one specified here

"reasoning_tokens" is a subset of "output_tokens" and
       therefore MUST be less than or equal to it

A context file MUST NOT be served with a "Content-Type" of "text/
   html"

A discovery mechanism defined in Section 4 MUST point at an index
      resource, never directly at a detail resource

A publisher advertising a context file through this mechanism MUST
   arrange that a GET request for "/.well-known/llm-context" on the
   origin returns either

Its value MUST be an absolute
   URI

A publisher MUST NOT use this record to advertise a context file
   whose retrieval the same robots.txt disallows

a consumer MUST
   apply the following precedence, highest first

A consumer MUST NOT retrieve more than one index resource per origin
   per retrieval cycle

A consumer MUST NOT attribute the content of a cross-origin index
   resource to the advertising origin

A consumer MUST impose its own ceiling on the size of any retrieved
   context file
the response MUST carry an appropriate "Content-Language"

a consumer MUST evaluate the exclusion
   rules of [RFC9309] against the index resource's URI before retrieving
   it

note: A member is a whole subject: a v0.1 report, a Run object, or a discovery snapshot. Each reject member is rejected under exactly one requirement and has an accepting twin in its family, so a validator that refuses every subject scores zero rather than full marks.
